params.body:
## What changes

`GET /preview/{token}` exchanges the token with the pipeline and renders the draft with `pages.article`, as a member reads it, under a bar saying it is a preview that is not published, and until when the link works. The payload goes through the same mapping as a published post (`Projection::articleAttributes`, split out of `upsertArticle`) and is never saved: no Article row, no tagging record.

What keeps a draft private:
- The token is the only way in. It is 32 characters, lives half an hour, and the pipeline knows it only as a hash. A malformed token never leaves the site. The route is throttled.
- `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.
- A robots meta instead of a canonical, no Article schema, no feedback strip.
- `robots.txt` disallows `/preview/`.
- Open past the holding page (`PreLaunch`), since the link is its own lock.
- An ended link and one that never existed show the same page (404).

## Checked

- `tests/Feature/DraftPreviewTest.php` is new, 6 tests. The full suite passes apart from `BuildStampTest`, which cannot read the branch ref from a git worktree.
- Local render against the local pipeline: headings and the picture in the text as on a live post; an ended link shows the ended page.

Merge after Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#420, which serves the preview to the site, and before Trendwolves/gentells-studio#74, which adds the Preview button.
params.title: A draft from the Studio on its real article page, behind a link that runs out
